description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Haste] to all allies, grants [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)], [Awoken Clanmate], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Awoken Clanmate
description.text: Black Magic and Dancer abilities don't consume uses, Black Magic and Dancer abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Trailing Combo after using two Black Magic or Dancer abilities

description.name: Trailing Combo
description.text: One single attack that deals 10000/20000/30000/40000/50000 damage at rank 1/2/3/4/5 of the triggering ability, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Lightning] after using a Fire/Ice/Lightning ability

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%
